name: Square Column Crystal Lamp
desc: A refined contemporary table lamp featuring a tall square crystal-style column base, brass-tone accents, and a wide cylindrical fabric drum shade. Its clean geometric form and warm neutral materials make it suitable for elegant living rooms, bedrooms, lounges, and hospitality interiors.

specifications.Light Distribution: Soft ambient illumination with broad shade diffusion
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 520 mm overall height x 360 mm shade diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Bedroom / Side table / Console table / Lounge / Hospitality
